name: Lace-spine Nipple Cactus
desc: Lace-spine Nipple Cactus (Mammillaria lasiacantha): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 5 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Mammillaria lasiacantha is a species of cactus in the subfamily Cactoideae, with the common names lacespine nipple cactus, small pincushion cactus, and biznaga de espinas pubescentes (Spanish).
